findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/UniversalEnveloping.lean:78-81 defines `ι` with `@[simps!]` under `set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false`; `Functoriality.lean:81-93` establishes the `map_ι`/`map_ι'` folded+unfolded convention this file inverts.
findings.fix: State both lemmas with `_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ (e i)` / `(h i)` so the proof terms match syntactically; if a simp-normal-form variant is wanted, add primed lemmas proved by `simpa using` the folded ones, with the same explanatory comment used in `Functoriality.lean:80` and `:87`.
findings.issue: `dividedPower_mem_kostantForm` (114) and `choose_mem_kostantForm` (122) are stated with `mkAlgHom ℚ L (TensorAlgebra.ι ℚ _)` but proved by `dividedPower_mem_kostantRootGenerators` / `choose_mem_kostantCartanGenerators`, whose types mention `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ _`. The terms typecheck only by unfolding `ι`, with no comment; only the unfolded form is exposed, so lines 130 and 135 must `simpa` back to the folded form.

findings.evidence: KostantForm.lean:235-239 vs. Functoriality.lean:176-180 (identical `apply LieHom.ext; exact e.symm_apply_apply` proof); KostantForm.lean:252 `congrFun (AlgHom.coe_toRingHom (map ℚ g.toLieHom)) x`.
findings.fix: Use the existing `mapEquiv ℚ g` and `mapEquiv_toAlgHom` (`Functoriality.lean:165,185`) to get injectivity, or state `hF` for `map ℚ g.toLieHom` and bridge to the `RingHom` coercion with an explicit `AlgHom.coe_toRingHom` rewrite; factor the `symm.comp = id` step into a named lemma in `Functoriality.lean` rather than duplicating it.
findings.issue: `hF : Function.Injective F` with `F := (map ℚ g.toLieHom).toRingHom` is filled by `map_injective_of_leftInverse`, which yields injectivity of the AlgHom coercion; the assignment relies on `AlgHom.coe_toRingHom` holding by `rfl`. The file itself needs that lemma explicitly at line 252, showing the two coercions are not syntactically equal. Lines 237-239 also re-prove `g.symm.toLieHom.comp g.toLieHom = LieHom.id`, already proved inline in `Functoriality.lean:177-179`.

findings.fix: Write the definition in term mode: `((map ℚ f).toRingHom.comp (kostantForm e h).subtype).codRestrict _ fun x => by rw [← map_kostantForm f e h]; exact ⟨x, x.property, rfl⟩`, then prove `coe_kostantFormMap_apply` by `rfl` or `RingHom.codRestrict_apply _ _ _ _`.
findings.issue: `kostantFormMap` is a data definition built by a tactic block (`by refine ... codRestrict _ ?_`), so its projection lemma `coe_kostantFormMap_apply` (213-217) can only be closed by `rw [kostantFormMap]; rfl`, unfolding the equation lemma and finishing by definitional equality instead of using the existing simp lemma.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:643 `Set.range_comp' (g) (f) : range (fun x => g (f x)) = g '' range f`; the supporting simp lemmas are `Associative.map_dividedPower` (Associative.lean:89-92) and `Ring.map_choose` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:533).
findings.fix: Add named lemmas `map_dividedPower_ι` and `map_choose_ι` stating `map ℚ f (Associative.dividedPower n (ι ℚ x)) = Associative.dividedPower n (ι ℚ (f x))` and the `Ring.choose` analogue, then derive each image equality in one step via `Set.range_comp'`. The same hand-unfolding of `range` in `kostantForm_le_iff` (145-154) is covered by `Set.union_subset_iff`, `Set.range_subset_iff` and `Prod.forall`.
findings.issue: `image_kostantRootGenerators` and `image_kostantCartanGenerators` each prove the same naturality equation twice by anonymous `by simp` (lines 167, 171, 180, 184) — four copies of a genuinely reusable fact (`map ℚ f` commutes with `dividedPower ∘ ι` and with `Ring.choose ∘ ι`) that downstream Chevalley work will need — and unfold `Set.range` membership by hand in both directions.

summary: Several proofs rest on undocumented definitional equality — the two membership lemmas are stated in unfolded `mkAlgHom ∘ TensorAlgebra.ι` form but proved by terms typed at `ι`, and the equivalence's injectivity hypothesis crosses the AlgHom→RingHom coercion. `kostantFormMap` is a tactic-mode data definition whose coe lemma is closed by `rw [def]; rfl`, and the naturality equation behind the two `image_*` lemmas is re-proved by bare `simp` four times instead of being a named lemma.
